verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents its own `omarchy` CLI as an alternative way to control the system that is otherwise driven through the Omarchy Menu, explicitly pitched for AI agents doing customization and configuration. Several UI or hotkey actions have CLI equivalents, such as reminders, snapshots and the Windows key, but full parity between the menu/UI and the CLI is never documented, and no HTTP API or OpenAPI spec exists. Missing for 10: documented proof that every menu/UI action has a CLI equivalent, a full CLI reference in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: you can also control it through the `omarchy` CLI. This is particularly helpful when you're having an AI agent work with you on customization or configuration.
You can also use the cli with `omarchy reminder 7 'Tea ready'`.
should you want to create your own, you can use omarchy-snapshot create.
